W.note: Most complete shop (search, filters, stock limits, drawer with steppers, totals, checkout, persisted cart) with solid states, but emoji art, badges and shadows add more chrome than a minimal brief wants.

X.note: Restrained line-art cards with labeled variant radios and live feedback, but oversized media boxes, no cart review or quantity control, and a visible dev toggle leave it sparse, and mobile is a long single column.

Y.note: Clean sale pricing and variant chips, but only three products on a mostly empty desktop, a text-only cart with no checkout path, and one card per screen on mobile wastes space.

Z.note: The densest desktop grid with clear hierarchy, inline ratings and a working drawer with steppers and checkout, though the mobile header wraps awkwardly and the Cart button drops onto its own line.
